title: CHRIST’S RESURRECTION AND OUR’S IN ROMANS
theme: Christ's resurrection establishes His deity and undergirds justification, new life, fruitful service, peace, salvation, and our resurrection hope.
proposition: Christ's resurrection assures believers of new life and their own resurrection, removing the fear of death.
sermonQuestion: What does Christ's resurrection mean for our salvation, present life, and future resurrection?

outline.heading: THE PATTERN OF NEW LIFE IN CHRIST
THE POWER FOR THE EXPRESSION OF THAT LIFE
THE PROVISION FOR OUR PEACE OF MIND
THE PROFESSION OF OUR FAITH FOR SALVATION
